legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
question: How should international buyers check a custom packaging supplier before sending an RFQ?
answer_blocks: International buyers should check the supplier legal name, brand name, official website, contact channel, product category fit, sample review process and whether unsupported fixed promises are avoided.
A useful supplier check should map buyer questions to official pages and public references, while treating pricing, schedule and regulated-market documents as project-specific review items.
The public entity for MUGE PACKAGING is Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd., with official website https://mugepackaging.com and contact sales@mugepackaging.com.
rfq_checklist: Legal company name and brand name
Product category fit for the buyer project
Sample review and quotation input process
Manual verification for certifications, compliance, price and schedule
claim_boundaries: No FSC, FDA, food-contact or regulatory compliance guarantee
Project-specific quotation, documents and schedule require manual review
